title: Create Studio: richer templates/fonts/customization and working downloads

requirements.summary: Expand procedural generation to produce 6+ distinct design previews and broaden template/texture preset catalogs.
acceptanceCriteria: In Create Studio, clicking “Generate Designs” produces at least 6 distinct previews (not just 3) for the same input.
The preview variations differ in layout and visual treatment (e.g., template/layout, background, texture) rather than only title/id.
The editor preset catalog in the UI includes additional Template options and additional Texture options beyond the current lists in frontend/src/components/createStudio/editorPresets.ts.
The additional presets are selectable in the editor and visibly change the preview output after applying changes.

file_operations.description: Update the deterministic/procedural generator to create at least 6 previews per generation and ensure variations differ by layout/visual treatment (e.g., more distinct layout variants, different background treatments, and/or different texture application) while remaining frontend-only.
Expand the preset catalog by adding more Template presets and more Texture options beyond the current arrays so users can select more high-quality variations in the editor.
Ensure the expanded Template and Texture preset lists are fully rendered/selectable in the editor UI and that selecting them continues to drive the Apply Changes flow to update previews.

requirements.summary: Add font family selection to the Create Studio editor and apply selected font family in rendered SVG previews.
acceptanceCriteria: The editor UI (DesignEditorPanel) includes a new control for choosing a font family (English UI labels).
Selecting a font family and applying changes updates the generated preview image (SVG) so the font style is visibly different.
DesignCustomization and related types are extended to persist the selected font family per design (frontend/src/components/createStudio/types.ts).
If no font is selected, a sensible default is used and existing designs continue to render without errors.

file_operations.description: Extend DesignCustomization to persist a selected fontFamily (and any supporting types if needed) while keeping backward compatibility via a sensible default when the field is missing.
Add a small set of web-safe font-family preset options (no external font CDNs) that the editor can present for selection.
Add an English-labeled font family control (e.g., a new tab or a section within existing controls) and wire it to the editor customization state so Apply Changes includes the chosen font family.

Apply the selected font family to the SVG output (both <text> elements and any foreignObject HTML text styling) with a default when unset, ensuring visible font changes across Invitation/Birthday/Wedding and other occasions.

requirements.summary: Implement functional per-design download so users can download the latest customized design with clear naming and errors.
acceptanceCriteria: The “Download” button in the generated design card grid (frontend/src/pages/CreateStudioPage.tsx) triggers a real download instead of doing nothing.
Downloaded file name is readable and includes the occasion and/or design title (e.g., "Birthday-Design-1.png").
The downloaded content reflects the latest applied customizations (template/texture/emojis/font, etc.) for that design.
If download fails for any reason, the user sees a clear English error toast/message and can retry.

file_operations.description: Wire the Download button to a real browser download flow using the design’s current rendered imageUrl (SVG data URL) and generate a readable filename including occasion/title (prefer .png export via SVG-to-canvas render; fall back safely if needed). Show a clear English toast on failure and allow retry.

requirements.summary: Add at least two additional customization controls (beyond template/style/texture/emojis) that persist per design and visibly affect preview output.
acceptanceCriteria: The design editor includes at least two additional customization controls beyond the current ones (Templates/Style/Texture/Emojis), with English labels.
Applying these additional controls results in a visible change to the design preview after “Apply Changes.”
New customization fields are persisted per design in the in-memory generatedPreviews state so reopening the editor shows the current selections.
No regressions: existing controls (template/style/texture/emojis) still work as before.

file_operations.description: Add new DesignCustomization fields for at least two additional controls (e.g., accentColor and borderStyle/cornerRadius) with defaults to prevent regressions and ensure existing designs render without errors.

Add at least two new English-labeled customization controls, wire them into the local customization state, and ensure the state initializes from design.customization so reopening the editor reflects current selections.

Ensure Apply Changes continues to persist the expanded customization object into the generatedPreviews state (so customizations remain attached to the design in memory) and no existing editor controls regress.

Update SVG generation to reflect the new customization controls with visible changes (e.g., apply accent color to key elements and apply border/corner styling) while keeping existing template/style/texture/emojis behavior intact.
